name: CFPS Workflow
description: OpenCFPS setup (SepiaBio), pipetting only, up to plate-done (no seal). Builds one master-mix tube per condition (positive control, negative control, sample) in cold-block holes, scaled by (reactions + extra) x per-well volume, then aliquots each into its destination wells. Uses generic epipette skills with epipette_10ul; the 10 uL cap is handled by chunked strokes inside the super skills.
author: b-kolar

inputs.name: pipette
inputs.description: Pipette to use (10 uL max, 0.5 uL min)

inputs.name: tipbox
inputs.description: Tip rack to draw fresh tips from

inputs.name: reagent_block
inputs.description: Cold block holding reagent tubes and the mix tubes (hole_1..hole_10)

inputs.name: reaction_plate
inputs.description: Destination well plate

inputs.name: extract_hole
inputs.description: Hole holding Extract (3.33X)

inputs.name: buffer_hole
inputs.description: Hole holding Buffer (2.5X)

inputs.name: ctrl_dna_hole
inputs.description: Hole holding Control DNA (200 nM)

inputs.name: sample_dna_hole
inputs.description: Hole holding Sample / plasmid DNA

inputs.name: water_hole
inputs.description: Hole holding Water / additives

inputs.name: pos_mm_hole
inputs.description: Hole where the positive-control master mix is built

inputs.name: neg_mm_hole
inputs.description: Hole where the negative-control master mix is built

inputs.name: sample_mm_hole
inputs.description: Hole where the sample master mix is built

inputs.name: vol_per_well
inputs.description: Volume dispensed per destination well in uL (15-30 recommended for 96 flatbottom)

inputs.name: extra_volume_ul
inputs.description: Fixed dead-volume overage (uL) added to each enabled master-mix tube

inputs.name: sample_dna_vol
inputs.description: Sample/plasmid DNA volume per 10 uL reference reaction (uL)

inputs.name: sample_water_vol
inputs.description: Sample water per 10 uL reference reaction (uL) = 3 - sample_dna_vol

inputs.name: pos_n
inputs.description: Positive-control reactions/wells (0 disables this mix)

inputs.name: neg_n
inputs.description: Negative-control reactions/wells (0 disables this mix)

inputs.name: sample_n
inputs.description: Sample reactions/wells (0 disables this mix)

inputs.name: pos_wells
inputs.description: Positive-control destination wells (comma-separated, e.g. A1)

inputs.name: neg_wells
inputs.description: Negative-control destination wells (comma-separated, e.g. A2)

inputs.name: sample_wells
inputs.description: Sample destination wells (comma-separated, e.g. A3,A4)

inputs.name: platesealer
inputs.description: PlateMax plate sealer

inputs.name: seal_holder
inputs.description: Stacked seal holder to peel a seal from

inputs.name: shaker
inputs.description: Wellplate shaker

inputs.name: plate_home
inputs.description: Object carrying the plate's home anchor (where the sealed plate is set back down)

inputs.name: shaker_running
inputs.description: Is the shaker/incubator ALREADY shaking right now? The shaker has no sensor, so the robot only knows what it was last told. Answer 'yes' only if it is running as you start this run.

inputs.name: shaker_slot
inputs.description: Shaker slot anchor to load the plate into

inputs.name: seal_index
inputs.description: 1-based seal position in the holder to pick

inputs.name: run_name
inputs.description: Name for this run's saved output folder (<run_name>_<timestamp>)

nodes.label: Record Shaker State
nodes.description: Write whether the shaker is already running into live_state, so the later off/on steps press the button only when they actually need to.

nodes.label: Log Plate Map
nodes.description: Print the destination plate layout (P/N/S) to the run log for reference.

nodes.label: Pick Up Pipette
nodes.description: Grab the pipette off its stand with the left arm.

nodes.label: Make Positive-Control Master Mix
nodes.description: Build the positive-control master-mix tube (Extract + Buffer + Control DNA + Water), batched and mixed.

nodes.label: Make Negative-Control Master Mix
nodes.description: Build the negative-control master-mix tube (Extract + Buffer + Water, no DNA), batched and mixed.

nodes.label: Make Sample Master Mix
nodes.description: Build the sample master-mix tube (Extract + Buffer + plasmid DNA + Water), batched and mixed.

nodes.label: Dispense Positive-Control Mix
nodes.description: Aliquot the positive-control mix into its destination wells.

nodes.label: Dispense Negative-Control Mix
nodes.description: Aliquot the negative-control mix into its destination wells.

nodes.label: Dispense Sample Mix
nodes.description: Aliquot the sample mix into its destination wells.

nodes.label: Place Pipette Back
nodes.description: Return whichever pipette is in hand to its stand (the run may have swapped to the 120 uL one).

nodes.label: Seal Plate
nodes.description: Grab the reaction plate short-side, seal it on the PlateMax (open door, load, pick + place seal, close door, press seal), unload it, and drop it back home.

nodes.label: Re-grab Sealed Plate
nodes.description: Pick the sealed plate back up (short-side) to carry it to the shaker.

nodes.label: Ensure Shaker Off
nodes.description: Turn the shaker off if it is currently running (state-aware; no-op if already off).

nodes.label: Load Plate Into Shaker
nodes.description: Place the sealed plate into the shaker slot and release it.

nodes.label: Start Shaker
nodes.description: Turn the shaker on (state-aware; no-op if already running).

nodes.label: Save Run Folder
nodes.description: Bundle the run log, any captured images, and the run inputs into a named, timestamped folder under the run's data store.
